name: @pipeworx/mcp-storting-no

tools.name: get_sessions
tools.description: List Norwegian Parliament (Stortinget) sessions. A session ("sesjon") runs ~Oct–Sep with an id like "2023-2024". Use the returned ids as sesjonid for other tools.

tools.name: get_cases
tools.description: List parliamentary cases/bills ("saker") for a session. Returns saker_liste with numeric case ids (sakid), titles, topics (emne_liste) and status.

sesjonid.description: Session id, e.g. "2023-2024". Get valid ids from get_sessions.

tools.name: get_representatives
tools.description: List members of parliament (MPs, "representanter") for a 4-year electoral period. Returns fornavn (first), etternavn (last), parti (party), fylke (county), kjoenn (gender).

tools.name: get_parties
tools.description: List all political parties ("partier") known to Stortinget. Returns id (e.g. "A", "H", "FrP"), navn (full name), and representert_parti (currently represented).

tools.name: get_votes
tools.description: List the votes ("voteringer") held on a single case. Returns sak_votering_liste; each has a votering id. Pass that id to get_vote_result for per-MP breakdown.

tools.name: get_vote_result
tools.description: Per-MP results ("voteringsresultat") for one vote: how each representative voted (for/against/absent). Pass a votering id from get_votes.

tools.name: export
tools.description: Generic fallback to any data.stortinget.no/eksport resource. Use for endpoints without a dedicated tool, e.g. resource "moter" (meetings), "komiteer" (committees) with params {sesjonid}. ?format=json is added automatically.

params.description: Query params, e.g. {"sesjonid": "2023-2024"}. Do not include format.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-storting-no forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the storting-no pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
